question: Do Telegram MiniApp confirmation approvals (پذیرش/تأیید) work and reach REAL code/effectors?

تأیید_proposal_approve.path: MiniApp POST /api/actions → miniapp_gateway → OpsActionEngine.execute → OctopusOpsDB.decide_proposal → INSERT outcomes.event_type=owner-decision
تأیید_proposal_approve.evidence: 18/18 owner-decision rows have effects_after=0 including P-091b88a78346 and P-ad115622f2ab (ziman-gallery)

پذیرش_rfc_approve.path_if_id_present: rfc.approve → decide_rfc → pending_card_recovery.persist_rfc_verdict → (doctor) claim_rfc_verdicts → begin_rfc_apply → ack
پذیرش_rfc_approve.reason: /api/lifecycle stalled_list intentionally omits rfc_id; UI still binds data-pid=String(c.rfc_id) → literal undefined

summary.undefined_titles_root_cause: Contract split 2026-08-06: _lifecycle_public_stalled_rows strips rfc_id; app.js renderLifecycle still displays/escapes c.rfc_id as title id line

root_causes.detail: Public lifecycle view returns only {created_ts,age_days}; UI expects c.rfc_id → String(undefined)==="undefined" on ~39 stalled cards
proposal.approve appends owner-decision (real DB write) but no production consumer turns approvals into outbox/effector work; UI honestly says هنوز هیچ اثری
miniapp_decision_ledger + _shadow_consume_decision_nonce exist; live routes do not call them (flag default off)

exact_next_fix: 1) Restore actionable stalled rows without leaking raw identity OR return server-minted decision handles: change get_lifecycle_state to include a decide_token / opaque handle that decide_rfc accepts; update app.js to render summary_prefix + handle (never String(undefined)). Until then disable پذیرش/رد when id missing.

2) Wire owner-decision consumer for legs (esp ziman-gallery): after decide_proposal APPLIED, enqueue durable outbox job OR have leg worker SELECT owner-decision with no later effector event and execute; append effector event so effects_after>0.
3) Keep decision-nonce ledger shadow until canary; do not claim effector success from ledger alone.
